newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE ends at six-week high on Wall St rally.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE ends at six-week high on Wall St rally.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index closed at its highest level for six weeks on Tuesday, encouraged by sharp gains in New York after U.S. economic data showed inflationary pressures to be easing, calming fears of a near-term interest rate rise.

The leading index added 43.5 points, or 0.99 percent, to finish at 4,433.2, just 11 points short of its closing high of 4,444.3, set on March 11. Gainers were in a two-to-one majority and trading volume picked up to the 800 million mark.
"We have seen quite an incredible performance recently considering the election is round the corner," said one dealer.
